name: genomewalk-ai

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/check-dist.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json

description: A private, conversational guide to your genome. Ask questions about your DNA and explore ClinVar annotations, gnomAD frequencies, and linked publications. Genome matching, search, and AI run locally in your browser. Your DNA and conversations stay on your device.
